support_steps.expected: Security has the indicators and exposure timeline without collecting the secret.

support_steps.do: Under the account-compromise procedure, have Security authorize containment and use the identity console to invalidate affected sessions and restrict access as required.
support_steps.expected: Known sessions are revoked and further sign-ins are controlled.

support_steps.do: Verify the employee's identity and coordinate approved password and recovery-method restoration from a trusted device.
support_steps.expected: The employee establishes new credentials and retains approved valid recovery methods.

support_steps.do: Review sign-in and mailbox audit records for unfamiliar access, forwarding or rules and remediate confirmed changes under the incident procedure.
support_steps.expected: Unauthorized activity is documented and approved reversals are recorded.

verify: Security confirms containment, the employee signs in safely from a trusted device and the review identifies any affected account changes.
escalate_when: Escalate immediately when any password, verification code or approval was submitted, or when suspicious sign-ins or mailbox changes appear.
keywords: typed company login on bad page

title: The work computer quarantined a file opened from an attachment
symptoms: I opened a file from an email and my work computer said it put the file in quarantine.
The attachment stopped opening and the warning named the file I had just clicked.
I still see the alert away from the browser, on the work computer itself.
error_messages: A threat was found and blocked.
cause: Endpoint protection detected a malicious attachment on the computer and moved the detected file into quarantine. The alert alone does not establish whether anything ran before the file was contained.
self_help_steps: Don't click anything else, and disconnect from the network if asked
Contact the help desk from a separate trusted device and report the alert time and computer name.
Leave the file quarantined and tell support whether you opened it before the alert appeared.

support_steps.do: Match the device and timestamp to the endpoint security event and preserve the relevant file identifier, process trail and action status.
support_steps.expected: A genuine endpoint alert and the quarantine outcome are confirmed.

support_steps.do: Review execution and connection telemetry for the time around the alert, then have Security isolate the device through the approved workflow if indicated.
support_steps.expected: The review determines likely execution and contains confirmed exposure.

support_steps.do: Search approved mail and endpoint telemetry for the same file identifier and sender indicators.
support_steps.expected: Related deliveries and endpoints are linked to the incident.

support_steps.do: Have Security direct remediation and check the endpoint again before restoring normal use.
support_steps.expected: Required remediation is recorded and no active detection remains.

verify: Security confirms the quarantined file is contained, evaluates any execution and clears the device for normal work.
escalate_when: Escalate on receipt. Flag urgently if the attachment ran, quarantine failed, or the same indicator appears on other devices.

title: A browser pop-up says my computer has a virus and asks me to call
symptoms: A page suddenly said my computer was infected and wanted me to call a number.
The warning has a phone number and asks me to let someone into my computer.
I only see it in that browser tab and haven't called or installed anything.
cause: A webpage can display a fake virus warning and pretend to be computer support. Its claim does not establish whether the device has a real infection.
self_help_steps: Don't click anything else, and disconnect from the network if asked
Leave the page alone and use a separate trusted device to call the help desk on a known number.
Tell support if you called, downloaded anything or allowed someone to control the computer.

support_steps.do: Check the device's endpoint alerts and approved browsing telemetry for the reported time without reopening the page.
support_steps.expected: The warning is traced to a webpage and any separate endpoint detection is identified.

support_steps.do: Ask whether any software was downloaded or run, credentials were entered, or remote access was granted, and confirm with telemetry where available.
support_steps.expected: Security determines whether the event is limited to a scare page or needs device or account containment.

support_steps.do: If Security confirms there was no interaction requiring containment, guide the employee to close the browser through normal window controls and decline session restore.
support_steps.expected: The page closes and does not return in a fresh session.

verify: The warning no longer appears and Security confirms whether any device or account action is required.
escalate_when: Escalate on receipt. Flag urgently if the employee called the number, installed software, entered credentials or allowed remote access.

title: Company phone was left behind and can't be found
symptoms: I think I left my company phone on the train and I can't find it.
The phone is still assigned to me, but I don't know who has it now.
I can't use the phone for work or receive my company sign-in prompts on it.
cause: The issued phone is no longer in the employee's possession. Someone who finds it may be able to reach work apps or a registered sign-in method.
self_help_steps: Don't click anything else, and disconnect from the network if asked
From a trusted device, call the help desk on a known number and report when and where you last had the phone.
Tell support whether the phone was locked and whether you used it to approve sign-ins.

support_steps.do: Verify the asset assignment and collect last known custody, lock state and sign-in method use in the restricted incident record.
support_steps.expected: The missing device is identified and its likely exposure is recorded.

support_steps.do: Check the last management contact, encryption and remote-lock state, then apply the authorized containment command if directed by Security.
support_steps.expected: Device access is restricted or Security can see that a command is pending.

support_steps.do: Coordinate suspension of the device's registered sign-in method and voice line through their authorized owners as required.
support_steps.expected: The missing device can no longer approve work sign-ins and the line status is recorded.

support_steps.do: Review device and account events from the loss window and record the replacement or verified recovery path.
support_steps.expected: Security has a disposition for the asset and the employee's access can be restored safely.

verify: Security confirms the asset's containment status and the employee regains work access through an approved replacement or cleared recovery.
escalate_when: Escalate immediately for any missing company phone. Flag an unlocked phone, sensitive data on the device or unexpected sign-in prompts.

title: Work laptop was stolen while a work session may still be open
symptoms: My company laptop was taken while I stepped away from my table.
I was signed in when it disappeared and I don't remember locking the screen.
There were work apps open and I don't know whether they can still be used.
cause: A company laptop was taken while an employee session might have been active. An open session can expose work apps before a device lock takes effect.
self_help_steps: Don't click anything else, and disconnect from the network if asked
Call the help desk using a known number from another trusted device and report the theft time.
Tell the responder which work apps were open and whether the display had locked.

support_steps.do: Verify the asset assignment, time of theft and reported session state in the restricted incident.
support_steps.expected: Security can identify the device and the period of possible access.

support_steps.do: Review last management contact, encryption and screen-lock evidence for the identified asset.
support_steps.expected: The case records what is known about device protection and active access.

support_steps.do: Under Security direction, revoke affected sessions, restrict the device's access and issue the authorized device containment command.
support_steps.expected: Accounts and device access are contained or pending commands are tracked.

support_steps.do: Review sign-in and app audit events since the last known custody and coordinate approved replacement access.
support_steps.expected: Suspicious activity is linked to the case and the employee has a controlled recovery path.

verify: Security records confirmed and pending containment actions, completes the initial exposure review and approves restored access on a trusted device.
escalate_when: Escalate immediately for theft, particularly when an active session or access to sensitive data is possible.

title: A missing work USB drive may contain company files
symptoms: I can't find the USB drive I used to carry work files between desks.
The laptop is still here, but the little drive with the files is missing.
I don't remember it ever asking for a password when I plugged it in.
cause: A removable drive holding copies of work files is missing. If encryption cannot be confirmed, someone with the drive may be able to read those copies.
self_help_steps: Don't click anything else, and disconnect from the network if asked
Call the help desk from a trusted device and report where you last had the drive.
Describe the types of files it may contain without copying sensitive contents into the ticket.

support_steps.do: Record the drive identity and last known custody in the restricted incident, using the employee's description and inventory if available.
support_steps.expected: Security has an asset identifier or a documented description and loss window.

support_steps.do: Review approved removable-media and encryption records for that device and ask the data owner to confirm the categories of files copied.
support_steps.expected: The encryption status is verified or recorded as unknown, and likely data exposure is scoped.

support_steps.do: Have Security document the disposition and coordinate the required response with the data owner.
support_steps.expected: The case records the exposure decision and who owns follow-up actions.

verify: Security records the drive's protection status and likely file exposure, and the data owner confirms any required follow-up.
escalate_when: Escalate immediately if the missing drive held work files, encryption is unknown, or sensitive records may have been exposed.
